نرتدع (form VIII)
# نَرْتَدِعُ (nartadiʕu) /nar.ta.di.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَدَعَ (irtadaʕa)
# نَرْتَدِعَ (nartadiʕa) /nar.ta.di.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَدَعَ (irtadaʕa)
# نَرْتَدِعْ (nartadiʕ) /nar.ta.diʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَدَعَ (irtadaʕa)
